summary: Iteration 3 full-stack verification of NEXOIN: settings GET/PUT, contacts API, quote emails, nav smooth-scroll fix, Contact page, Admin settings panel, quote list filters/status, language switch. Backend: 14/14 pytest tests pass. Frontend: all requested flows pass (desktop + mobile). No blocking issues found.

minor.issue: Emails are awaited inline inside the request handler (adds ~400-700ms per request; slower/timeout provider would delay the API response). Consider BackgroundTasks.
Admin/ops data and settings mutation are fully unauthenticated (by design per request, but any visitor can change the notification email).

action_items: Optional: move email sending to FastAPI BackgroundTasks so POST /api/quotes and /api/contacts respond immediately.
Optional: consider a lightweight guard for /api/settings PUT and /admin since it mutates public contact info.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: send_email is awaited in the request path for quotes/contacts - use BackgroundTasks to decouple latency/failures.
PUT /api/settings has no validation on contact_email (plain str, not EmailStr) - an invalid email can be saved and rendered as a mailto link in the footer/contact page.
No DELETE endpoints for quotes/contacts, so test data accumulates in the admin console (6 quotes + 3 contacts currently include TEST_ rows).
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_ quotes (TEST_Logistics BV, TEST_Undeliverable, TEST_UI Freight) and TEST_ contacts (TEST Contact, TEST QA UI) via public APIs/UI. Cannot be deleted (no DELETE endpoints). Settings were reset to defaults: notification_email='', contact_email=ops@nexoin.eu, contact_phone=+32 10 000 000, contact_locations='Rotterdam · Frankfurt · Lyon' (verified by GET).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (14 tests, module fixture restores settings to defaults after the run; note pytest.ini runs xdist so settings-mutating tests can race with quote tests - keep settings tests in the same class/scope). Verified: nav smooth-scroll aligns #services/#manifesto/#network at ~80px offset (desktop + mobile menu), nav-contact -> /contact, contact form posts to /api/contacts and shows contact-success, quote form (q-cargo is a shadcn Select - must click trigger then [role=option], not fill) shows quote-success, admin settings save persists and footer/contact/quote pages reflect new values, filter tabs (all 6 / new 4 / contacted 1 / closed 1) and admin-set-contacted-{id} work, FR/DE/EN switch works and NEXOIN brand stays untranslated. Email logs confirm both internal notification and customer confirmation sent (202 for delivered@resend.dev, 422 for ops@nexoin.eu, API still 200).
rca_of_the_issue: One transient read reported the footer email as the default value immediately after navigation while phone/locations were already updated; a re-check with a 2s settle showed the correct value (qa@resend.dev) in footer text, mailto href and the Contact page - a render-timing read in the test, not an app defect.
